messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"text":"You will be cast down by them as stubble, and they will be to you as fire.","verse":61,"chapter":15},{"text":"They will devour you, your cities, your land, and your mountains. They will burn all your forests and your fruitful trees with fire.","verse":62,"chapter":15},{"text":"They will carry your children away captive, and will plunder your wealth, and mar the glory of your face.”","verse":63,"chapter":15}],"chapter":15,"book_code":"2ES"}

response_format: JSON object with book_code='2ES' and verses array. Each item has chapter, verse, text_ar, review_notes_ar. Return exactly verse numbers 61,62,63 in this chapter.
